commands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,160p' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean; rg -n 'substOld|\\.Subset\\.app' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean Strata/Transform/OldExpressions.lean; rg -n 'def getVars|def substOld' Strata"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '155,223p' Strata/Languages/Core/OldExpressions.lean; rg -n 'getVars' Strata/DL/Lambda/LExpr.lean | head -45; sed -n '2825,2860p' Strata/Transform/CallElimCorrect.lean; cat lean-toolchain; ls -a | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '290,318p' Strata/DL/Lambda/LExpr.lean; rg -n 'Subset|subset' Strata/DL/Util/ListUtils.lean; rg -n 'HasVarsPure|instHasVars' Strata/Languages/Core/Expression.lean Strata/Languages/Core/Env.lean; lake env lean --print-prefix"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > candidate.lean <<'EOF'
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have join {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}
      (ha : a.Subset (c ++ [h1])) (hb : b.Subset (d ++ [h1])) :
      (a ++ b).Subset ((c ++ d) ++ [h1]) := by
    simp only [List.Subset, List.mem_append] at *
    intro x hx
    exact hx.elim
      (fun h => (ha h).elim (fun h => Or.inl (Or.inl h)) Or.inr)
      (fun h => (hb h).elim (fun h => Or.inl (Or.inr h)) Or.inr)
  simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars]
  induction post <;> simp only [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
  case const => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case bvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case fvar => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case op => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  case abs ih => exact ih
  case quant trih eih => exact join trih eih
  case ite cih tih eih => exact join (join cih tih) eih
  case eq ih1 ih2 => exact join ih1 ih2
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    · split <;> simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    · exact join ih1 ih2
EOF
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('candidate.lean')
s = p.read_text().replace('    · split <;> simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]\\n', '    · split\\n      · exact List.subset_append_right _ _\\n      · exact List.subset_append_left _ _\\n')
p.write_text(s)
PY
python check_candidate.py candidate.lean"

method_note: Shell commands and visible correctness outcomes only; no reasoning text. rg/sed is a literal command-presence indicator, not a semantic retrieval score.
